request.text: I need a new Android tablet with at least 8 GB of RAM and a screen of 11 inches or larger. Can I collect one at a specific shop in Tripoli? What will it cost?

message:
A confirmed specification match is Mobileleb’s Samsung Galaxy Tab A11+ Wi-Fi, silver, 8GB RAM/256GB storage, at $290.00. It is listed as Brand New and available online, with an 11-inch screen and Android 16.
However, I could not verify a specific Tripoli shop address or stock for collection there. Online availability does not confirm branch stock, so this is not a confirmed Tripoli pickup offer.
My suggestion: confirm a Tripoli collection location and availability with the retailer before paying or travelling.

product.description:
Samsung Galaxy Tab S9 FE Gray 8/256GB
The Samsung Galaxy Tab S9 FE Gray 8/256GB is a high-performance tablet designed for those who need a reliable, versatile device for work, creativity, and entertainment. With a sleek, minimalist design and powerful features, this tablet is perfect for both personal and professional use.
Elegant Gray Design with Durable Build
The Galaxy Tab S9 FE in Gray showcases a premium, modern look with a durable build that’s perfect for daily use. Its lightweight and slim profile make it easy to carry, whether you’re commuting, traveling, or working from home.
Stunning 12.4-Inch Display with Vibrant Colors
Enjoy a vivid viewing experience on the 12.4-inch display that offers vibrant colors and sharp details, ideal for streaming, reading, and browsing. The expansive screen with minimal bezels provides an immersive experience, making it perfect for watching movies, sketching, and multitasking.
Powerful Performance with Exynos Chipset
Equipped with an Exynos chipset, the Galaxy Tab S9 FE delivers fast and smooth performance, allowing seamless multitasking and quick app switching. Whether you’re running productivity apps, graphic design software, or games, this tablet handles it all effortlessly.
Enhanced Audio with Dual AKG Speakers and Dolby Atmos
The dual AKG speakers with Dolby Atmos provide rich, immersive sound quality, enhancing your audio experience. Enjoy clear, surround sound whether you’re watching videos, listening to music, or on a video call
